review_scope: All nonretail prose in six geographic blocks
method: Read every nonretail paragraph alongside all cited own-date headlines; checked all quoted market and treasury instruments, exact values, signs, horizons, units and actual session tags; assessed release status, chronology, roles, proposal versus action, result versus expectation and flow versus price. Retail excluded and preserved. No later-date sources used.

findings.finding: Japan and Australia had missing return horizons after prior currency removal; restored explicit twenty-session wording matching the own card.
Ceasefire scenario used pending-agreement framing despite own-date Atlantic Council n2762 explicit deal-struck headline. Updated to agreement reached with implementation still a future test.

n3913 was used five times across full report. Removed the redundant completed-purchase fact and citation from nonretail catalyst; retained supported proxy-valuation discussion. Final reuse four, no uncited purchase assertion left.
Made China currency translation conditional rather than an observed FX conclusion; corrected year/currency spacing.

actions.new: Over 20 sessions, the ASX 200 at 8,359.40 points was up 1.34%; Commonwealth Bank at AUD 154.46 had gained 7.14%, while BHP at AUD 39.86 was down 7.39%.

actions.old: Decrypt reports a $5.4 billion bitcoin purchase, while Yahoo Finance reports a new short bet during bitcoin's record-price period. [[n3913]] [[n1261]] These are competing company developments around a shared underlying asset, not proof that either equity valuation is correct.
actions.new: Yahoo Finance reports a new short bet during bitcoin's record-price period. [[n1261]] The disagreement highlights the extra valuation decision made by a buyer of the corporate proxy: enthusiasm for the underlying asset does not by itself establish the appropriate price for the common equity.

actions.finding: Use eligible own-date explicit agreement headline; distinguish agreement reached from implementation still to be tested, rather than outdated pending-agreement framing.
actions.old: South China Morning Post reports China urging Iran to avoid military action as an Israel-Hezbollah ceasefire approaches. [[n2759]] This is a prospective de-escalation development, not proof that every implementation stage has succeeded or that all regional risks have disappeared.
actions.new: Atlantic Council describes Israel and Lebanon striking a ceasefire deal and asks whether the Israel-Hezbollah war is really over. [[n2762]] An agreement is not proof that implementation has succeeded or that all regional risks have disappeared. The pending investment test is whether de-escalation holds, rather than whether a deal can first be reached.

retained_checks: All quoted equity/index/crypto/fund/treasury figures and actual sessions match own card, including twenty-session Sony, five-session PZU/CD Projekt and twenty-session Dino returns.
Dell actual earnings reaction remains separate from preceding regular-session close; company-wide forecast weakness is not rewritten as absence of AI demand.
Nvidia strong revenue versus lofty investor expectations, Amgen clinical effect versus market hurdle and Abercrombie raised guidance versus market expectations remain distinct comparisons.
China growth figure is an advisers recommendation, OPEC+ delay is under discussion, Nippon-US Steel appeal is not completed approval and Intel public funding remains conditioned support.
Polish Witcher4 full production is a production milestone, not a released game or current sales; existing catalogue sales and insurer results remain separately sourced.
Fed overnight operating-rate discussion is not presented as completed easing or a new asset-purchase program.
